name: Tensor Field Ray Bending (Visualization Method)
definition: A method assuming the tensor volume is a lens that distorts an image. It uses backward ray tracing through the tensor volume to generate image distortions that show internal properties of the tensor field.
summary: Tensor Field Ray Bending visualizes tensor volumes as optical elements that distort light rays, revealing continuous deformation patterns on a 2D plane to avoid the clutter of glyph-based methods.
